域名的 whois 最后更新时间在最近 1 天内发生了变化，说明注册信息被修改过: The domain's whois last-updated timestamp changed within the last day, meaning the registration information was modified. If this was not your own action, the domain may have been hijacked or transferred.
域名距离到期不足 30 天。域名过期会导致解析立即失效，所有依赖该域名的服务（含: The domain expires in less than 30 days. Expiry makes resolution fail immediately and breaks every service that depends on the domain, including certificate issuance validation.
域名距离到期不足 7 天，属于必须当天处理的事项。一旦进入过期状态，域名会先停止: The domain expires in less than 7 days and must be handled today. Once it expires, resolution stops first and the domain then enters the redemption period, where recovery costs far more than renewal.
